evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

cases.name: Hollow warranty mechanics
cases.query: Review the warranties in this software license. We are the customer — what can we actually rely on?
files: license: 90-day performance warranty, breach claims must be reported within 10 days of discovery, sole and exclusive remedy is re-performance, followed by a broad AS-IS disclaimer of all implied warranties
baseline_risks: Reports 'vendor warrants performance for 90 days' as solid protection
expected_behavior: Traces promise -> breach -> remedy: 10-day claim window + re-performance-only exclusive remedy
Computes the disclaimer net (implied warranties gone; only the narrow express one remains)
Concludes the practical protection is thin, with each mechanic cited
Flags disclaimer effectiveness as jurisdiction-specific for counsel
must_not: Present the 90-day warranty as strong protection without the remedy trace

cases.name: Knowledge qualifier and undefined knowledge
cases.query: Does the seller promise the software doesn't infringe anyone's IP?
files: agreement where seller reps non-infringement 'to Seller's knowledge', with 'knowledge' undefined
baseline_risks: Answers 'yes, there's a non-infringement warranty' dropping the knowledge qualifier
expected_behavior: Reports the promise at its qualified strength: only to Seller's knowledge
Flags that 'knowledge' is undefined (actual vs constructive) as an interpretation gap
Explains the practical difference (unknown infringement is the buyer's problem) and suggests the negotiation fix

cases.name: Missing disclosure schedule
cases.query: Review the seller's reps and warranties in this asset purchase agreement.
files: APA where several reps are given 'except as set forth on Schedule 3.4' and Schedule 3.4 is not attached
baseline_risks: Analyzes the reps as written, never noticing the exceptions schedule that could gut them is missing
expected_behavior: Flags Schedule 3.4 as referenced-but-missing and the reps as unassessable until provided
Explains that the schedule's contents define the real scope of the promises
must_not: Assess the reps as clean while their exceptions schedule is absent

cases.name: One-way warranty section framed as mutual
cases.query: Counterparty says the warranty section is 'completely standard and mutual'. Confirm so we can move on.
files: contract where the customer gives extensive reps (authority, compliance, data ownership, export control) while the vendor gives only authority, and all vendor performance warranties are disclaimed
expected_behavior: Inventories per party and shows the asymmetry: customer promises much, vendor almost nothing
Ranks the asymmetry and suggests the reciprocal asks
must_not: Endorse the mutual framing the inventory contradicts

cases.name: Liability cap question
cases.query: What's the maximum the vendor would owe us if they breach — walk me through the liability cap.
baseline_risks: Skill could run a warranty review for a cap-exposure question
expected_behavior: Recognizes a liability-cap/exposure question; routes to liability-indemnification-review
must_not: Produce a warranty inventory for a cap question
